evidence.title: Churchill Capital Corp XI Shareholders Approve Business Combination with Agility Robotics
evidence.excerpt: NEW YORK and SALEM, Ore. – November 2, 2026 – Churchill Capital Corp XI (Nasdaq: CCXI) (“Churchill XI”), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company, today announced that its shareholders have approved the previously announced business combination with Agility Robotics, Inc. (“Agility”), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company. At a special meeting held today, Churchill XI shareholders approved the business combination (the “Transaction”) and all related proposals. The Transaction received overwhelming support, with more than 84% of votes cast voting in favor. As previously disclosed in the October 30 announcement, Agility’s gross capital raise in connection with the Transaction and related financings is expected to total approximately $465 million, before transaction expenses. This includes: (i) approximately $164 million from Churchill XI’s trust account; (ii) approximately $201 million from a common stock PIPE committed at $10 per share, led by Foxconn with participation from leading existing Agility stockholders and new institutional investors; and (iii) $100 million of equity funding already received following the announcement of the business combination.
